title: Monitoring
description: Truck status and retained fault reports.
withFaults: With fault reports in the window
faultsWindow: Reports in the window / latest code
faultsHint: Reports include added and removed faults. Counts describe reports in the window, not all currently active faults.
logHint: Newest events first. No data does not establish whether a truck is powered off. Date filters use the Branch time zone. Refreshes every 60 seconds while visible.
search: Search truck, code or event details
loadError: Monitoring data could not be loaded. Retry the request.
emptyHint: Records appear after monitoring is enabled and the server collects data. No example data is shown.
disabled: Monitoring is disabled for this Branch. Existing records are retained within the configured window.
serverSwitch: Collection also requires the server switch FLEET_KARMA_MONITORING_ENABLED=true.
serverUnknown: This page cannot verify whether the server switches are on.
unavailable: Select a Branch and enable the Fleet service to use Karma monitoring and settings.
settingsDescription: Monitoring settings apply to the selected Branch. Saving changes collection intervals and log retention.
collectionHint: Enable monitoring for this Branch and choose whether to request fault reads.
intervalsHint: Status polling, history polling and device fault reads run independently. Log retention defaults to 10 days.
commandHint: Sends a read-only fault command to online trucks every {minutes} minutes. It also requires device commands to be enabled on the server (FLEET_DEVICE_OPERATIONS_ENABLED=true). It does not clear faults.
saveError: Monitoring settings could not be saved.
retrySave: Your changes are kept. Review the fields and retry.

enabled.label: Enable monitoring
enabled.hint: Collect and keep truck connectivity changes and fault reports for this Branch.

faultCommandEnabled.label: Read faults from online trucks
faultCommandEnabled.hint: Request the read-only fault logger command.

statusPollSeconds.label: Status poll interval (seconds)
statusPollSeconds.hint: 30–3600 seconds. How often the server checks for fresh truck data.

offlineAfterMinutes.label: No-data threshold (minutes)
offlineAfterMinutes.hint: 2–1440 minutes. After this time without fresh source data, a truck is shown as no data.

faultHistoryPollMinutes.label: Fault history interval (minutes)
faultHistoryPollMinutes.hint: 5–1440 minutes. How often the server collects fault reports from Karma history.

faultCommandMinutes.label: Fault command interval (minutes)
faultCommandMinutes.hint: 15–1440 minutes. Time between read-only fault commands to an online truck.

retentionDays.label: Keep the log (days)
retentionDays.hint: 1–30 days; default 10. Older log records are deleted automatically. Reducing this period can remove older records.
